objective: Construct, on every L x M torus beyond a fixed size, configurations whose only winding wall is a designed staircase, and prove them selective for each kind of bending contact; record any kind for which the construction is not achieved.
status: Proved by WALLS-WITH-CHOICES-20261024-001C-P001 (V1 prose proof, standard-library check passed). For the eight bending contacts with directed walls or without a free place (54, 62, 109, 110, 147, 151, 155, 203), planted configurations in the relative twist (1, 1) are selective on every L x M torus with L, M >= 3: the planted staircase up column 0 and along row 0 is the only periodic wall (for 109 and 151 also a braid, all other walls being loops around vertices, by a count of all 12 L M states), it blocks (1, 0) and (0, 1) and serves (1, 2) and (2, 1). For the four bending contacts whose walls turn both ways and have a free place (111, 125, 159, 215) no uniform construction was found: on 3 x 3 and 3 x 4 none of their configurations contradicts along every odd class, so a planted wall has no quiet background; their selectivity on every large torus stays open.
title: Selective on every large torus
